decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=REPLY, dst=/net/downlink/a/net/downlink/cli/reply-ep, src=<pair 3:1>, kind=RESULT, payload=VALUE u32=1234 } - the success reply exactly as the TERMINUS emits it: reply dst = the request's accumulated src (the return route), reply src SEEDED with the PAIR of the vertex that served it (RFC-0029 6.2), so the origin learns a PAIR chain without asking for one.
decoded.note: Bytes CHANGED 2026-10-23 (#2245): src was the request dst /sensor/temp (12 B body); it is now the served vertex's PAIR (11 B body). dst is untouched (RFC-0029 13.4: the fwd-reply-* vectors keep their dst bytes and gain the 6.2 src).
